import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 410;
    static final int M = 200020;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int[][] d = {{-1,0},{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1}};
    static int[][] dis = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];
    static char[][] g = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] h = new char[12][12];
    static int n, t;

    static boolean in(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(tim[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        tim[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int code = q.poll();
            int x = code / 10, y = code % 10;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + d[i][0], ny = y + d[i][1];
                if (in(nx, ny) && g[nx][ny] >= '0' && g[nx][ny] <= '9' && tim[nx][ny] > tim[x][y] + 1) {
                    tim[nx][ny] = tim[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int code = q.poll();
            int x = code / 10, y = code % 10;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + d[i][0], ny = y + d[i][1];
                if (in(nx, ny) && h[nx][ny] >= '0' && h[nx][ny] <= '9' && dis[nx][ny] > dis[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (tim[nx][ny] >= dis[x][y] + 1) {
                        dis[nx][ny] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                        if (tim[nx][ny] > dis[nx][ny])
                            q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int[] fst = new int[N];
        int[] vv = new int[M];
        int[] nxt = new int[M];
        int[] cap = new int[M];
        int[] flow = new int[M];
        int e;
        int[] d = new int[N];
        int[] cur = new int[N];
        int s, t;

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(fst, -1);
            e = 0;
        }

        void add(int u, int v, int c) {
            vv[e] = v; nxt[e] = fst[u]; cap[e] = c; flow[e] = 0; fst[u] = e++;
            vv[e] = u; nxt[e] = fst[v]; cap[e] = 0; flow[e] = 0; fst[v] = e++;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            d[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int i = fst[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                    int v = vv[i];
                    if (d[v] == -1 && cap[i] > flow[i]) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int a) {
            if (u == t || a == 0) return a;
            int ret = 0, f;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                cur[u] = i;
                int v = vv[i];
                if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && (f = dfs(v, Math.min(a, cap[i] - flow[i]))) > 0) {
                    a -= f;
                    ret += f;
                    flow[i] += f;
                    flow[i ^ 1] -= f;
                    if (a == 0) break;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        int gao(int _s, int _t) {
            s = _s;
            t = _t;
            int ret = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                System.arraycopy(fst, 0, cur, 0, N);
                ret += dfs(s, INF);
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                g[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                h[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs1(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        Dinic go = new Dinic();
        go.init();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9') {
                    go.add(S, i * n + j + 1, g[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (h[i][j] > '0' && h[i][j] <= '9') {
                    go.add(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, h[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (h[x][y] > '0' && h[x][y] <= '9' && dis[x][y] <= t) {
                                go.add(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ret = go.gao(S, T);
        System.out.println(ret);
        sc.close();
    }
}
